title: Retrieving a Natural Number's Binary Representation
statement: Let $J$ be a bit string and let $v_1,\ldots,v_m$ be a finite list of natural numbers. Encode the list of their binary representations by concatenating the pair encodings of those representations with empty second components. Applying the word-retrieval procedure to the pair encoding of $J$ and this encoded list returns the binary representation of the entry at index $|J|$, taking that entry to be $0$ when the index is out of range.
